headline: Names a federal courthouse in Sherman, Texas, after Paul Brown.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. courthouse at 101 East Pecan Street in Sherman, Texas, as the Paul Brown United States Courthouse. It is an honorary designation and does not change how the courthouse operates. The official summary does not describe any other changes.
when_it_takes_effect: Took effect when enacted on December 20, 2013.
